title: $p$-numerical semigroup of the sequence of consecutive odd integers
summary: We prove the $p$-Frobenius problems proposed as Conjectures 7.1 and 7.5 developed by T. Komatsu and R. Pandey (Bull. Korean Math. Soc. 2025;62:1397--1409.) for two families of consecutive odd integers. For integers $r,L,n\ge0$, the bounded restricted partition function $p_{\le r}^{(\le L)}(\le n)$ counts partitions of $n$ into at most $r$ parts, each at most $L$. Thus the bounded restricted partition functions $p_{\le 3}^{(\le a)}(\le s)$and $p_{\le 3}^{(\le a+1)}(\le s)$ play central roles in the proofs.
